description: Reporte de carga y buques (2025) is a dataset listed in Mexican national open data portal (datos.gob.mx), an open data portal, published or maintained by Administración del Sistema Portuario Nacional Mazatlán, S.A de C.V (ASIPONA MAZATLÁN). Reporte mensual de carga y buque por tipo de tráfico y tipo de carga. Coverage: Puerto de Mazatlán. The portal files it under the publisher Administración del Sistema Portuario Nacional Mazatlán, S.A de C.V (ASIPONA MAZATLÁN). Its tags are asunto marítimo, comercio, infraestructura portuaria, movimiento portuario, puerto. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-03-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mx-portal.
